variants.title: Powder XRD refinement: SrTiO3 perovskite oxide
variants.sample: Strontium titanate powder, cubic perovskite Pm-3m (the data card lists its atom positions)
variants.method: index with the perovskite model, least squares on sin²θ
variants.note: a = 3.905 Å. Atomic positions are held at the ideal perovskite values, not refined.

source.title: SrTiO3 bulk lattice parameter 3.905 Å
source.note: as stated in the Wikipedia article 'Strontium titanate' (no inline citation there); not checked against the ICDD card in this build

variants.title: Powder XRD refinement: CoFe2O4 spinel ferrite
variants.sample: Cobalt ferrite powder, inverse spinel Fd-3m (oxygen parameter fixed, illustrative)
variants.method: index with the spinel model, least squares on sin²θ
variants.note: a = 8.3919 Å (unsourced / illustrative: handbook value entered from memory, not re-checked). Cation sites use average scattering; oxygen x = 0.256 (origin choice 2) is illustrative. Counts are scaled up because a large cell scatters less per line.

source.title: CoFe2O4 lattice parameter 8.3919 Å (ICDD PDF 22-1086 as remembered)
source.note: unsourced / illustrative: handbook value entered from memory, not re-checked in this build

variants.title: Powder XRD refinement: two-phase mixture, 60 wt% Si + 40 wt% SrTiO3
variants.sample: Silicon (standard) mixed with strontium titanate, 60 : 40 by weight
variants.method: index two phases, refine both lattice parameters and both scale factors, Hill-Howard weight fractions
variants.unknown: the weight fraction of silicon and the two lattice parameters
variants.note: No matrix-absorption correction (the two phases are assumed to absorb alike); the weight fraction shown is the silicon fraction.

source.title: Silicon a = 5.43102 Å (as remembered; ICDD PDF 27-1402 lists about 5.4309 Å) and SrTiO3 a = 3.905 Å
